notes: Every release in this list now shows the day it landed and the Eastern time it landed at, the way the notes before 80.6.12 always did - not a bare 2026-10-30 with no clock on it.
Nine of those dates were wrong as well as bare: 80.6.12 through 80.6.20 landed on the evening of October 29, and were dated the 30th.
The app itself is unchanged; nothing about your songs, your lists or the side rail moves with this.
